title: A "merged main" hand-off proves the head contains origin/main
why: Lane guard-pr-runs-windows-shards told runner 8 that #1543 "holds main" while its base 394ad4863 was 14 commits behind main d70ebd14d. A fix check caught missing 22-minute caps on #1627 (coordinator, 23:28 CST Nov 7).
note: Fix: before a "merged main" hand-off, the merge tool's hand-off or lane lint fetches and checks `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD`. Done check: a red test where a head behind origin/main is refused with the missing count. Related: step measure-reads-fresh-clone. Not a queue fix; waits under the item 384 hold.
